capacity_usable_kwh.notes: InsideEVs (US coverage of the 2026 refresh): 112.6 kWh usable, BMW-reported (evspecifications and KBB relay the same set, M70 112.8). Conflict: the BMW global release gives 108.9 kWh usable energy content; the gap is 4-6 %.
BMW global release: usable energy content 108.9 kWh (launch text; the later 2026 refresh coverage quotes higher figures).

chemistry.notes: Estimated: the iX M70 xDrive shares the facelift iX large pack and 195 kW DC with the xDrive60 (data on file); ADAC lists Nickel-Mangan-Cobalt for the xDrive60 (ab 03/25) and the pre-facelift M60 (111.5 gross, 195 kW). No ADAC page found for the M70 itself.
